ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the fluke surface, contrasted against low-intensity black margins and a central peduncle connection.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the majority of both lobes. A distinct vertical dark band extends from the base into the median notch. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge and lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped median notch with a sharp vertex angle approximately between 60-80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, small-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire horizontal trailing edge, with more pronounced jaggedness near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex horizontal sweep along the trailing edge, terminating in sharp, upwardly-curved lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixels (approx. 5-10 clusters) detected against the black background of the far lateral tips, particularly on the right fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, low-intensity linear marks detected on the white surface, including a diagonal scratch on the left lobe and multiple short vertical disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular indentations and minor pixel-level 'tears' along the trailing edge boundary; dark vertical scratch-like markings visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black pigment 'bleeding' or intrusion patterns visible near the interior boundaries of the median notch, extending into the high-intensity white regions.
